searchText: Frames Breakout #6 <t:1791297000:R> ✨ https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/82474738131?pwd=GZPZ2YoOaPrLRuu4gArwtci5UqODub.1 Hey! Sorry I couldn't attend, we are ensuring everything remains safe and sound in Sepolia 🙏 Please let me know if there's any actionable from our side (I'll what the recording, though) front-running forkcast: - frames-devnet-1 targeting thursday next week - spec team targeting early next week for a test release - adding 8250, 8272, 7906 to scope - 500k gas limit - matt to merge the "deploy frames expiry verifier as standard contract" PR - barnabas to add an item to ACDE agenda this week to discuss strategy/timeline for merging frames & focil devnets - couple other items that need feedback, incl. a max_fee PR from matt, motivated by anders' presentation last week. daniil has some open PRs looking for feedback too. For these keyed nonce PRs re. `frames-devnet-1`: - This looks required: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12406 - Should be deferred I think: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12352 - Also I added a PR for some clarifications, to align on what clients do: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12440 Frames Breakout #6 For recent roots it looks like we are missing the `RECENT_ROOT_CODE` from the EIP, I'm assuming its this: https://github.com/ethereum/sys-asm/pull/53 Started a tracker for `frames-devnet-1`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3727 PTAL, in case there is anything missed!
